description: Guardrail 11: 'When triage.sh reports forced: true, the level is not up for debate ... A sensitive path ... always escalates to L regardless of how few files are touched.' Guards against a one-line diff to a sensitive path being waved through as S/M just because the diff is small.

given.scenario: Fixture project whose .rush/config.json declares security.sensitive_paths: ['src/auth/']. Request: a one-line change to src/auth/login.ts.
